rows.title: Crypto-erasure completeness and verifiable deletion
rows.requirement: ONSure shall not claim deletion, offboarding completion, or crypto-erasure completion unless every in-scope payload copy, derivative, key binding, backup/replica location, queued job and retained evidence obligation is accounted for and the applicable erasure method is verified against an authorized payload-scope policy. Missing scope, unknown copy lineage, undeleted key material, or unresolved regulated-retention conflict yields HOLD/BLOCKED rather than COMPLETE.
acceptance_criteria: exact in-scope payload population is explicitly enumerated or deterministically derived
all key bindings and cryptographic deletion dependencies are accounted for
retention conflicts are explicitly resolved by current authority before deletion completion
payload scope policy is authority-bound and versioned
regulated-industry erasure SLA remains separately authority-controlled
missing or unverifiable deletion evidence cannot produce PASS
rows.safe_floor: unknown payload scope, unresolved retention conflict, active key binding, unaccounted copy or unverifiable erasure => HOLD/BLOCKED
rows.positive_oracle: all authorized in-scope copies and key bindings accounted for with zero unresolved retention conflict and verifiable erasure evidence

rows.title: Self-referential AI safety claim qualification
rows.requirement: ONSure shall treat self-referential AI safety claims as a distinct high-risk claim category. A system, model, evaluator, guard, policy engine or assurance component may not establish its own safety, independence, robustness, compliance or qualification claim solely from evidence it authored, selected, interpreted or promoted. Positive qualification requires independently sourced adversarial evidence and an authority-bound oracle; absent that evidence the claim remains HOLD/INCONCLUSIVE.
acceptance_criteria: self-referential safety claim category is explicitly identifiable
claim author/evidence author/evaluator/oracle/promotion authority lineage is disclosed
positive qualification requires independent adversarial evidence
minimum adversarial fixture set is versioned by follow-up design authority before QUALIFIED status
missing independent adversarial evidence yields HOLD/INCONCLUSIVE
the subject cannot self-promote its own qualification
rows.safe_floor: self-referential authority loop or insufficient independent adversarial evidence => HOLD/INCONCLUSIVE
rows.positive_oracle: no material self-approval loop and independently sourced adversarial evidence meets the current authority-bound minimum set

implementation_rule: The legacy 40-DD denominator may not satisfy Design Closure after this extension is adopted. Until DD-041 and DD-042 have current independent qualification and current runtime evidence, every premerge/design-lock gate remains HOLD_NONFINAL.
